## Purpose

Editable sources for the hand-drawn MIL-STD-882E process maps: who does what, in which order, and where a change sends the work back. The records and the generated figures say what is true of this project; these maps explain the process around them. This page is generated from the sources, so it shows when an export has fallen behind its source.

## Boundary diagram

![Figure 4 · Boundary diagram](assets/docs/diagrams/figures/fig-4-boundary-diagram.svg)

| # | From | To | Crossing / interaction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | draw.io editor | Map sources | .drawio files, edited by hand |
| 2 | Map sources | SVG exports | exported by hand to docs/wiki/images |
| 3 | SVG exports | Wiki and READMEs | process-map wiki page, standards and safety READMEs |
| 4 | Term list and 882E tailoring | Diagram sources | what each abbreviation stands for, task disposition |
| 5 | Map sources | Generated README and model | lanes, steps, labels read by diagrams_readme.py |
| 6 | CI | Generated README and model | regenerated and compared (--check) |

**Explicitly excluded:** the project's actual status (that is in the records and their generated figures), normative MIL-STD-882E flowcharts, and the SVG exports themselves (in `docs/wiki/images`).

## Changing a map

1. Edit the `.drawio` source in draw.io (diagrams.net).
2. Export it to SVG as `docs/wiki/images/<name>.svg`, with the same labels.
3. Regenerate this page (`python3 tools/figures/diagrams_readme.py`); Figure 1 shows an export that has fallen behind. Then run the full check list in [`CLAUDE.md`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/CLAUDE.md).
